description: YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data: description, country, subscriber/view/video counts, external links, and any email addresses the creator wrote in the public description. YouTube's hidden 'view email' address needs a CAPTCHA and is not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_channel_search when you need YouTube channels matching a search query: channel id, name; social_youtube_shorts when you need Latest Shorts of one YouTube channel from its public Shorts. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

handle.description: Channel handle, with or without @ (e.g. @YouTube). 3-30 letters, digits, . _ -
